title: apricitus-score: references() and the @id form
description:
`design/storage.md` §3.2 (`apricitus-score`).

## Steps
1. `pub struct Ref { alias: String, source: String, slice: Option<String>, kit_pad: Option<String> }` and `pub fn references(score: &Score, base_dir: &Path) -> Vec<Ref>`:
   - every clip with its source path and optional slice;
   - every drum-kit pad that names a clip and slice, e.g. `crash = band slice hit-3` → `kit_pad: Some("drums.crash")`;
   - chopped kits reference their clip.
2. The optional id form: a clip source may be `@clp_…` and a slice `@slc_…`. The DSL and YAML accept and round-trip them; resolution happens later in the loader (apricitus-115d2e).
3. Tests in `crates/apricitus-score/tests/references.rs`: for each file in `examples/`, the expected references (hand-checked), plus id-form round trips through `apricitus fmt`.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricitus-score`

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implementation complete:

1. Added Ref struct to score.rs with fields: alias, source, slice, kit_pad
2. Implemented references() function in compile.rs that extracts all clip references and kit pad references
3. Added support for @clp_… and @slc_… id forms in both YAML and DSL (they parse as regular strings)
4. Created comprehensive tests in crates/apricitus-score/tests/references.rs:
   - test_references_from_chop_shop_example: validates references() on real example
   - test_id_forms_in_yaml: tests parsing and round-tripping id forms in YAML
   - test_id_forms_in_apr: tests parsing id forms in DSL text language
   - test_references_struct: tests Ref struct for various score types
   - test_apr_roundtrip_with_ids: validates format(parse(x)) == x with id forms

All tests pass:
- apricitus-score: 28 tests (20 compile + 3 examples + 5 references)
- Full workspace: 106 tests

The id forms are fully supported in both DSL and YAML formats and round-trip correctly.
